name: get_flag
description:
Retrieve one feature flag in a project by ID or slug. Use an exact id or slug returned by list_flags; do not infer slugs from code, environment variable names, or SDK keys. Scope the call to the team that owns the project. A not-found error usually means the flag is not in this project or the project or team is wrong: list the project's flags instead of retrying.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel --scope {teamSlugOrId} flags inspect {flagIdOrSlug} --project {projectIdOrName}. Fill placeholders from inputs.

ifMatch.description: Etag to match, can be used interchangeably with the `if-match` header

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.

withMetadata.description: Whether to include metadata in the response
